scope.purpose: Inject controlled discontinuities into isolated copies of the verified F1+F2+F3 artefact chain and measure detection/localization behavior.

historical_single_fixture.interpretation: One malformed fixture, not six independent SHACL tests.

detects: RDF post count when regenerated from Gold
traceability map regeneration from nonzero ontology values
post IRI construction from Gold IDs
limits: does not compare an externally mutated RDF graph to Gold unless rerun or paired with an inventory check
does not validate semantic correctness of activations

detects: Gold ID set equals traceability post ID set
stable post IRIs are present in traceability
selected nonzero activation count equals traced selected activation count
limits: does not detect every duplicate trace key
does not compare every ontology value cell
does not validate optional RDF triples

detects: SHACL conformance against declared shapes
validation result count in report graph
limits: SHACL conformance is structural conformance, not semantic truth
optional or undeclared constraints are not detected
current stress fixture bundles multiple violations in one graph

detects: selected feature existence in Gold
selected feature presence in traceability
train-only selection and lexicon scope metadata
limits: does not reconcile every selected input cell value

detects: duplicate IDs in split partitions
missing partition IDs in Gold
selected cell value, split, and post IRI mismatches
duplicate trace keys
feature-order mismatches in metric files
prediction order mismatches for enriched runs
dataset hash mismatches in metric files
limits: depends on campaign metric/prediction availability for run linkage
older public report text may refer to seven variables and must not be reused as F1+F2+F3 evidence

detects: record-to-RDF report count mismatches
selected activation trace report mismatches
selected input cell report mismatches
SHACL report baseline nonconformance
prediction duplicate IDs, missing IDs, split mismatch, and y_true mismatch
limits: consumes prior reports and can be fooled by stale success reports unless producers are rerun
does not prove runtime model consumption unless metrics contain semantic_input_provenance

extension_checks_required.purpose: Parse mutated RDF and compare rr:Post/rr:identificador set exactly against Gold IDs.
Require every report to cite input hashes that match the mutated artefacts used in the current case.
Recompute selected input matrix fingerprints and compare row ID order, feature order, dtype, shape, and values to manifest.
Hash ordered prediction assignments per model/condition/seed when the claim concerns unchanged output assignment.
Extract focus node, result path, source constraint component, severity, and message family from each SHACL report.

controls.mutation: Copy baseline package to case directory without changing scientific artefacts.
controls.original_detector_expectation: All applicable original checks should pass.
controls.acceptance: No detector reports a discontinuity; counts match baseline.

controls.mutation: Permute rows of results/traceability/traceability_map.csv without changing any row content.
controls.original_detector_expectation: audit_traceability and audit_model_input_cells should pass because trace rows are reconciled by post_id and feature.
controls.acceptance: No false positive; row order is not treated as a scientific identity relation for traceability rows.

controls.mutation: Reserialize posts.ttl with changed triple order but identical RDF graph.
controls.original_detector_expectation: run_shacl_conformance should pass; byte-hash-only checks may differ and must not be used as semantic failure evidence.
controls.extension_required: RDF graph isomorphism or inventory check should confirm logical equivalence.
controls.acceptance: No continuity exception after graph-level comparison; byte hash difference is reported only as serialization difference.

controls.mutation: Regenerate reports from unchanged case copy.
controls.original_detector_expectation: Original producers should reproduce pass status and core counts.
controls.acceptance: Report timestamps or serialization details may change; scientific counts and status do not.

fault_cases.mutation: Remove one traceability row for a nonzero selected feature.

oracle_expected.broken_relation: selected semantic activation to source record

fault_cases.original_detector_expectation: audit_traceability should reduce traced_selected_activations; audit_model_input_cells should report missing_nonzero_trace_cells.
fault_cases.acceptance: Detector reports the missing post_id-feature relation and status is attention_required or equivalent failure.

fault_cases.mutation: Remove all triples for one rr:Post from posts.ttl while leaving Gold and reports unchanged.

oracle_expected.broken_relation: Gold record to RDF resource

fault_cases.original_detector_expectation: run_shacl_conformance may still conform because the missing post is no longer a SHACL target; reconcile_artifact_chain may miss the case if it trusts stale materialization_report.json.
fault_cases.acceptance: Extension reports missing RDF resource for the Gold post ID; original miss is preserved if observed.

fault_cases.mutation: Add one extra SHACL-conformant rr:Post with an identifier absent from Gold.

oracle_expected.broken_relation: RDF resource set exceeds Gold record set

fault_cases.original_detector_expectation: SHACL should pass if the extra post satisfies shapes; existing reconciliation may miss stale report mismatch.
fault_cases.acceptance: Extension identifies extra RDF post ID without calling it a SHACL violation.

fault_cases.mutation: Duplicate one traceability row with the same post_id and feature.

oracle_expected.broken_relation: unique post-feature trace key

fault_cases.original_detector_expectation: audit_model_input_cells should report duplicate_trace_keys.
fault_cases.acceptance: Duplicate key count is positive and duplicated key is listed.

fault_cases.mutation: Duplicate one ID inside GEN_split_gld_reddit_ids_v02.json and remove another ID from the same split to preserve split length.

oracle_expected.broken_relation: unique partition membership

fault_cases.original_detector_expectation: audit_model_input_cells load_parts should raise a duplicate identifier error.
fault_cases.acceptance: The duplicate ID and missing displaced ID are reported.

fault_cases.mutation: Duplicate one prediction row ID and remove another test ID in one prediction file.

oracle_expected.broken_relation: unique test prediction assignment

fault_cases.original_detector_expectation: reconcile_artifact_chain should report duplicated prediction ID and ID-set mismatch.
fault_cases.acceptance: Prediction duplicate count is positive and the missing test ID is reported.

fault_cases.mutation: Swap two rows in test_raw_float64.npy while leaving test_ids.json and manifest.json unchanged.

oracle_expected.broken_relation: ordered post IDs to matrix rows

fault_cases.original_detector_expectation: No public original script in the preflight set is guaranteed to recheck prepared .npy files against manifest unless the freeze verifier or a new manifest rechecker is invoked.
fault_cases.acceptance: Recomputed matrix_sha256 differs and row-level comparison identifies the two affected IDs.

fault_cases.mutation: Permute rows in one enriched prediction CSV while preserving IDs and y_true values.

oracle_expected.broken_relation: test prediction order to declared test order for enriched run linkage

fault_cases.original_detector_expectation: audit_model_input_cells should report prediction_order_mismatches for enriched run linkage; reconcile_artifact_chain may pass set-based ID checks.
fault_cases.acceptance: Order-sensitive run-linkage detector flags the mismatch; set-based pass is recorded as partial detection.

fault_cases.mutation: Swap two columns in test_raw_float64.npy while leaving selected feature order unchanged.

oracle_expected.broken_relation: ordered selected features to matrix columns

fault_cases.original_detector_expectation: Metric feature-order checks detect only metric metadata changes, not silent .npy column swaps.
fault_cases.acceptance: Recomputed matrix_sha256 differs and column-level comparison identifies swapped features.

fault_cases.mutation: Replace one selected feature name in ENR_selected_ont_features_anova_train_only.json with an unknown ont_* feature.

oracle_expected.broken_relation: selected feature exists in Gold and traceability

fault_cases.original_detector_expectation: audit_model_inputs should list the unknown feature as missing or untraced.
fault_cases.acceptance: Missing/untraced feature list includes the injected feature.

fault_cases.mutation: Change one nonzero selected semantic value in Gold while leaving traceability_map.csv unchanged.

oracle_expected.broken_relation: Gold selected value to trace value

fault_cases.original_detector_expectation: audit_model_input_cells should report value_mismatches.
fault_cases.acceptance: Value mismatch count is positive and affected cell is listed.

fault_cases.mutation: Change one traceability value for a nonzero selected feature while leaving Gold unchanged.

oracle_expected.broken_relation: trace value to Gold value

fault_cases.original_detector_expectation: audit_model_input_cells should report value_mismatches.
fault_cases.acceptance: Trace mismatch is localized to the mutated post_id-feature pair.

fault_cases.mutation: Change one value in test_train_standardized_float64.npy while leaving raw values, scaler, and manifest unchanged.

oracle_expected.broken_relation: train-fitted transformation to prepared matrix

fault_cases.original_detector_expectation: Freeze verifier can detect transformed value mismatch if adapted to the case copy; public chain reconciler does not.
fault_cases.acceptance: Recomputed standardized value/fingerprint differs and cell is localized.

fault_cases.mutation: Move one test ID to train and one train ID to test in the split JSON while leaving Gold split column unchanged.

oracle_expected.broken_relation: frozen partition membership

fault_cases.original_detector_expectation: reconcile_artifact_chain should report test split symmetric difference; audit_model_input_cells should detect downstream order/hash changes when regenerated.
fault_cases.acceptance: Moved IDs are listed and status is attention_required.

fault_cases.mutation: Set split='train' for one row in a test prediction CSV.

oracle_expected.broken_relation: prediction row belongs to test split

fault_cases.original_detector_expectation: reconcile_artifact_chain should count prediction split mismatch.
fault_cases.acceptance: Prediction split mismatch count is positive and affected row is identified.

fault_cases.mutation: Change post_iri for one nonzero traceability row to an IRI inconsistent with stable_post_iri(post_id).

oracle_expected.broken_relation: trace row to stable RDF post IRI

fault_cases.original_detector_expectation: audit_model_input_cells should report post_iri_mismatches for selected features; audit_traceability may report missing expected IRI only at aggregate level.
fault_cases.acceptance: Affected post_id-feature IRI mismatch is localized.

fault_cases.mutation: Remove one rr:trataSobre triple for a post that has a nonzero concept activation.

oracle_expected.broken_relation: activation concept to RDF concept assertion

fault_cases.original_detector_expectation: SHACL may still conform because rr:trataSobre is not required for every active concept; existing trace checks may miss RDF triple absence.
fault_cases.acceptance: Extension reports missing concept assertion and SHACL pass is interpreted as a declared limit.

fault_cases.mutation: Replace one rr:trataSobre object with an IRI that is not a skos:Concept in rrdom:ContextoCienciaTecnologia.

oracle_expected.broken_relation: RDF domain concept target conforms to declared concept scheme

fault_cases.original_detector_expectation: run_shacl_conformance should produce a validation result for the SPARQL domain concept rule.
fault_cases.acceptance: SHACL report identifies rr:trataSobre or rr:perteneceDominio concept target violation.

fault_cases.mutation: Change y_true for one test prediction row while leaving Gold unchanged.

oracle_expected.broken_relation: prediction reference label to Gold label

fault_cases.original_detector_expectation: reconcile_artifact_chain should detect y_true mismatch.
fault_cases.acceptance: Mismatch is reported for the mutated post_id.

fault_cases.mutation: Permute y_pred values among rows while preserving IDs, y_true, split, model, condition, and seed.

oracle_expected.broken_relation: prediction output assignment to ordered test records

fault_cases.original_detector_expectation: Existing reconciliation is expected to miss this if it checks IDs, split, and y_true only; metric recomputation may reveal metric drift but not original output provenance.
fault_cases.acceptance: Extension detects ordered prediction-assignment hash mismatch; original non-detection is documented.

fault_cases.mutation: Remove one selected traceability row but keep the previous traceability_audit_report.json with status passed.

oracle_expected.broken_relation: report freshness against mutated traceability input

fault_cases.original_detector_expectation: reconcile_artifact_chain may be fooled if it trusts stale report counters; audit_model_input_cells should detect the underlying trace fault if run directly.
fault_cases.acceptance: Harness fails the stale report even before accepting chain reconciliation output.

fault_cases.mutation: Introduce a SHACL violation in posts.ttl but leave baseline_report.json from the pristine graph.

oracle_expected.broken_relation: SHACL report freshness against RDF input

fault_cases.original_detector_expectation: reconcile_artifact_chain may pass if it reads the stale baseline_report.json; run_shacl_conformance should fail when rerun.
fault_cases.acceptance: Stale report is rejected and regenerated SHACL report exposes the violation.

shacl_cases.original_detector_expectation: run_shacl_conformance should fail if the fixture is passed as data graph.
shacl_cases.acceptance: One independent fixture produces a result for missing rr:identificador.

shacl_cases.fixture: Set rr:identificador to a value containing uppercase or punctuation.
shacl_cases.acceptance: Report path/component correspond to identifier pattern.

shacl_cases.fixture: Add rr:probPos with decimal value 1.5 to one rr:Post.
Add rr:probPos, rr:probNeu, rr:probNeg values whose sum differs from 1 by more than 0.02.
shacl_cases.original_detector_expectation: run_shacl_conformance should fail when all three probability properties exist.
shacl_cases.acceptance: Report classifies the SPARQL probability-normalization rule.

shacl_cases.fixture: Set probabilities so the maximum class differs from rr:etiquetaSentimiento.
shacl_cases.original_detector_expectation: run_shacl_conformance should fail when label and probability triples are present.
shacl_cases.acceptance: Report classifies the label/probability consistency rule.

shacl_cases.fixture: Make rr:trataSobre point to a resource that is not a skos:Concept in rrdom:ContextoCienciaTecnologia.
shacl_cases.acceptance: Report classifies invalid domain concept target without implying semantic truth.

shacl_cases.fixture: Add a second rr:Post with the same rr:identificador as an existing post.
shacl_cases.original_detector_expectation: run_shacl_conformance should fail through duplicate identifier SPARQL rule.
shacl_cases.acceptance: Report identifies duplicate identifier rule; focus-node multiplicity is recorded exactly as pySHACL reports it.

shacl_cases.original_detector_expectation: run_shacl_conformance should fail if the fixture target class is present.
shacl_cases.acceptance: Report localizes concept scheme membership violation.

summary_requirements.manuscript_boundary: Report E1 as controlled validation of declared continuity checks, not as semantic validation or exhaustive fault coverage.
